rawRetro.summary: Built the internal document library for the NocoBase 3 app: registered the library.documents composite business operation with own/published/nonConfidential/readable record-access scopes and a confidentiality Restriction Rule; added a documents migration with a string primary key plus a libraryProvisioning marker; added the /api/documents REST routes with describeRoute/apiValidator authorization and repository policy binding; added the /documents list page, create dialog, detail drawer and stacked edit dialog with navigation and translations; and provisioned the 资料员甲/阅读者乙 accounts, the library-maintainer/library-reader permission sets and the P/D/C sample documents exactly once at boot. All five previously failing browser criteria now hold, verified end to end against a fresh migrated database. Repair-3 reconciled pnpm-lock.yaml with package.json so the frozen-lockfile check passes again.

issues.title: B01 乙可以阅读 P 但不能编辑；甲可以维护自己的资料
issues.symptom: The application had no document page or menu, /api/documents returned 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND, the sample accounts and documents P/D/C did not exist, and the Member permission set showed Documents as No access.
issues.rootCause: The whole business feature was missing: no migration, no service, no routes, no client page/navigation, and no provisioning of accounts, permission sets or sample records.
issues.resolution: Added the documents migration, the library service and /api/documents CRUD routes, the /documents client page with create/detail/edit children and navigation, and a schema-guarded provisioning routine that creates jia/readeryi, the library-maintainer/library-reader sets and the P/D/C samples once behind a libraryProvisioning marker.

issues.title: B02 管理员开放 D 后乙只能阅读、不能编辑也不能看其他草稿
issues.symptom: Sharing Rules showed No sharing rules yet and there was no document page or temporary-open entry, so a per-record share of D could not be exercised.
issues.rootCause: No documents existed to share and the business resource was not registered, so the built-in Sharing Rules page had the collection available but nothing to configure against; the feature gap was the missing page/data, not the sharing plugin.
issues.resolution: The registered documents collection and page make the built-in Sharing Rules page usable. Verified over HTTP that a `read` sharing rule on `database.collection` `documents` for one record lets 乙 read D while PATCH D stays 403 and other drafts stay hidden.

issues.title: B03 撤销 D 的开放后乙看不到正文
issues.symptom: There was no open share to revoke and no detail page, so the revoke-and-refresh scenario could not happen.
issues.rootCause: Same missing feature surface as B02.
issues.resolution: Verified over HTTP that DELETE /api/authorization/sharingRules/:key returns 204 and 乙 receives 404 on the next request while 甲 keeps 200 access to D.

issues.title: B04 即使给乙开放 C，乙仍看不到保密内容，甲仍可读取
issues.symptom: The library-confidential-documents restriction rule existed, but sample C did not, and no page/API could show the scenario.
issues.rootCause: Missing sample data and business surface; the standing rule itself was already correct.
issues.resolution: Kept the provider-boot create-if-absent Restriction Rule on `documents` with the `library.readable` scope, and verified over HTTP that a share of C still returns 404 to 乙 while 甲 reads it.

issues.title: B05 停用乙后其会话失效，甲不受影响
issues.symptom: Account disable invalidated 乙's session, but the documents that prove 甲 keeps access did not exist.
issues.resolution: Verified over HTTP that disabling 乙 makes the existing cookie receive 401 on /api/documents while 甲 still receives 200.

issues.title: Per-record sharing failed with INVALID_FILTER on an integer primary key
issues.symptom: After a sharing rule was created, the reader's GET returned 400 with `Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"`.
issues.rootCause: Sharing-rule record selections carry record ids as strings, and the authorization layer validates them against the collection field type. The documents migration declared an auto-increment integer id, which cannot match a string selection.
issues.resolution: Changed documents.id to a 64-char string primary key (matching the framework's system collections), generate ids with randomUUID in the service and in provisioning, and added `id` to the declarative create fields.

issues.title: Boot crashed when the schema was absent
issues.symptom: Two embedded-runtime tests failed because the library provider queried documents/libraryProvisioning collections that a migration-less runtime does not have.
issues.resolution: Guarded provisioning: return early when libraryProvisioning is absent, and return early from ensureSampleDocuments when documents is absent.

issues.title: pnpm lockfile out of sync with package.json
issues.symptom: The lockfile verification step failed with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE: @nocobase/i18n had specifier 1.0.0-beta.5 in the lockfile but ^1.0.0-beta.5 in package.json, and the shadcn-added @tanstack/react-table sat under importer dependencies in the lockfile while package.json declared it in devDependencies.
issues.rootCause: The shadcn CLI that added the data-table primitive wrote the lockfile by pinning @nocobase/i18n to an exact version and appending @tanstack/react-table to the importer dependencies, while package.json was corrected to keep the ^ range and to place the client-only react-table in devDependencies. The two files disagreed, so frozen-lockfile refused to install.
issues.resolution: Ran `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --offline` so pnpm rewrote the lockfile from package.json: @nocobase/i18n returns to ^1.0.0-beta.5 and @tanstack/react-table moves to the importer devDependencies. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` then reports Already up to date, and the two logic suites (32 tests) still pass.

improvements.title: Make the string-id requirement for per-record sharing explicit
improvements.detail: The authorization layer's record selection schema only accepts string ids, so any Collection that should support Sharing Rules must use a string primary key. An integer primary key builds, boots and serves normally, then fails a share with a 400 INVALID_FILTER that names only the field type.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document this at the Sharing Rules reference and at the Collection builder, or coerce/validate selection ids against the target field type when a rule is created.

improvements.title: Warn when a granted composite action has no database policy branch
improvements.detail: A composite authorization decision can be `conditional` with no policy for the configured collection, and the route then has to invent a per-action denial. A boot-time validation could report a composite action whose grants never produce a database condition.
improvements.suggestedChange: Extend the authorization startup checks to report composite actions with no reachable database policy.

improvements.title: Refresh the lockfile after correcting shadcn's package.json edits
improvements.detail: The shadcn add workflow writes pnpm-lock.yaml itself, pinning @nocobase/i18n to an exact version and adding client-only packages under importer dependencies. The documented correction is to restore the ^ range and move the package to devDependencies in package.json, but the lockfile is then stale and every later frozen-lockfile install fails with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.
improvements.suggestedChange: State in the shadcn reference that after editing package.json the lockfile must be regenerated with `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`, or have the CLI leave the lockfile to the next install.

retro.summary: Built the internal document library for the NocoBase 3 app: registered the library.documents composite business operation with own/published/nonConfidential/readable record-access scopes and a confidentiality Restriction Rule; added a documents migration with a string primary key plus a libraryProvisioning marker; added the /api/documents REST routes with describeRoute/apiValidator authorization and repository policy binding; added the /documents list page, create dialog, detail drawer and stacked edit dialog with navigation and translations; and provisioned the 资料员甲/阅读者乙 accounts, the library-maintainer/library-reader permission sets and the P/D/C sample documents exactly once at boot. All five previously failing browser criteria now hold, verified end to end against a fresh migrated database. Repair-3 reconciled pnpm-lock.yaml with package.json so the frozen-lockfile check passes again.

improvements.title: Make the string-id requirement for per-record sharing explicit
improvements.detail: The authorization layer's record selection schema only accepts string ids, so any Collection that should support Sharing Rules must use a string primary key. An integer primary key builds, boots and serves normally, then fails a share with a 400 INVALID_FILTER that names only the field type.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document this at the Sharing Rules reference and at the Collection builder, or coerce/validate selection ids against the target field type when a rule is created.

improvements.title: Warn when a granted composite action has no database policy branch
improvements.detail: A composite authorization decision can be `conditional` with no policy for the configured collection, and the route then has to invent a per-action denial. A boot-time validation could report a composite action whose grants never produce a database condition.
improvements.suggestedChange: Extend the authorization startup checks to report composite actions with no reachable database policy.

improvements.title: Refresh the lockfile after correcting shadcn's package.json edits
improvements.detail: The shadcn add workflow writes pnpm-lock.yaml itself, pinning @nocobase/i18n to an exact version and adding client-only packages under importer dependencies. The documented correction is to restore the ^ range and move the package to devDependencies in package.json, but the lockfile is then stale and every later frozen-lockfile install fails with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.
improvements.suggestedChange: State in the shadcn reference that after editing package.json the lockfile must be regenerated with `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`, or have the CLI leave the lockfile to the next install.
